entities.name: Emilian Bratu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Emilian Bratu was a Romanian chemical engineer, founder of chemical engineering education in Romania. With the Austrian physical chemist Otto Redlich, he studied the dissociation constant of heavy water.
